tested_behavior: Recognize only bridge-origin IllegalStateException write failures; handle wrapped and cyclic causes safely.
Actual native Overview Save Changes button invokes the unchanged production bridge, whose blocked write appears in an actionable modal dialog.
Actual WINDOW_CLOSING event and native save confirmation show the same error and keep the editor window available.
Blocked writes preserve dirty state, root identity, staged JSON, selected revision and original fixture bytes; no native write is entered and no automatic retry occurs.
The event-dispatch thread remains responsive; unrelated runtime exceptions reach the normal uncaught handler.
After the controlled process-list block is removed, an explicit native Application.n retry creates a verified backup, writes exact staged synthetic JSON, and clears the dirty flag.
